title: The sync range leak gate refuses internal-root content that the tracked-file scan accepts, so a team clone cannot sync its own internal facts
goal: kbpublic.range_leaks reads the files of an internal root and of a pointer for secrets only, as tree_hits does, so a team clone's sync leak gate passes the internal-root facts the tracked-file scan passes; a secret in a file of an internal root or of a pointer is still refused by the sync leak gate, as is any hit in a file outside them; kbpublic.SCAN_FORM is above 6, so no range verdict cached under the old rule is read; a root or pointer whose visibility is anything but public (no visibility line, or another value) is refused by the tree refusal of publish and the sync gate, with the refusal naming the value it found or saying there is no visibility line
